verdict_text:
YES

The script drops every tensor of blocks 2, 6, 10 and 14, and renumbers the survivors by enumeration order, which yields exactly the mapping listed in clause 2 (3 to 2, 4 to 3, 5 to 4, 7 to 5, 8 to 6, 9 to 7, 11 to 8, 12 to 9, 13 to 10, 15 to 11). Only the index segment of each name changes, tensors are passed through by reference, and the four non-block tensors are copied unchanged. The assertions run before any write: the layer-index set must equal 0..11, which rules out any remaining block 12 to 15 and proves exactly 12 blocks, and the tensor count must be 184. A failed assertion exits non-zero with nothing written, and the file lands at `out/T1/model.safetensors`.

One caveat outside the spec text: the script imports a helper module `_ckpt` for loading, so it is only self-contained if that module ships alongside it.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
